projects.title: Tico
projects.description:
▸ Developed a mobile application with Android Studio to help users find meals that taste like home
▸ Designed the application’s UI with Figma using a user-centered approach
▸ Integrated Google’s Geocoding, Places, and Translation APIs to acquire restaurant details and translate the information accordingly
▸ Utilized Firebase Firestore to store and manage data as well as user authentication and authorization

projects.title: Nested
projects.description: Native Android mobile application to help students find roommates. The app follows a social-media like flow that included multi-tab navigation for ease of use, in-app messaging, profile creation with multiple image upload, and intuitive swiping capabilities in the home screen. Developed using a wide range of native libraries and open-source libraries. Designed using Figma. Implemented with custom XMLs.
